all_six_full_certificate.meaning: Root-owned normalization of actual separately fixed all-six full-FP32 receipts; copy measured deltas/resources and bind raw receipts. It is not permission to fabricate passes or replace measurements with this planned schedule.
all_six_full_certificate.per_control: One row for each of six arms: complete_public_episode_passed, original_phi_commit_passed, finite_values_states_diagnostics_and_feasibility_passed, constructed_states_discarded all true; actual_episode_counts equal the per-arm QUEUE expected counts after measuring.
all_six_full_certificate.raw_result_evidence: Nonempty immutable raw actual-result descriptor list; each raw result must be PASS with zero fits/updates and no A/VALID/TEST scoring. Retain all preceding failures separately.

all_six_full_scope_decision: Distinct immutable JSON with controls in fixed order, fixed_before_execution=true and full_context_FP32=true; root owns numeric deadline and actual invocation scope.
failure_accounting: Counters increment before staged operations and before every physical native callback. Durable JSONL retains attempted work after hard termination. Python failure preserves all attempted counters/resources, phase/arm/episode and completed endpoints; no COMPLETE.json on failure.
independent_review_evidence: Exactly candidate_source and scientific_source rows: evidence immutable path/hash/bytes, reviewed_source_sha256, unresolved_blocking_source_defects=0. Candidate review binds original disabled sequential; scientific review binds this disabled worker. Plain-text reviews are hash-checked without JSON parsing.
pre_W_public_identity_preflight: Before load_public_w, validate the frozen projection/ID-only roles and full public context through unchanged accessor._projection/_public_context, compare certificate graph/roles/processed-edge hashes, then cross-check W-reader provenance. No label arrays are opened by this preflight.
scientific_resources: Freeze positive max elapsed/RSS and CUDA allocated/reserved limits before any fitting; require the root external watchdog for mid-call interruption, plus worker checks before each acquisition update/episode and completion. No arbitrary limits were adopted here.
synthetic_result: Immutable actual RESULT.json: PASS_SYNTHETIC_SEQUENTIAL_PARITY_ONLY, mode synthetic, all_six_controls_compared, caller_states_and_flags_and_gates_unchanged, candidate_pin SHA exact disabled sequential; zero model_fits/persistent_updates and false A_scoring/VALID_TEST_access.
